Quest name: The Land of Ice (Chrono Quest - 3rd period, 18th Century)
Quest location: St. Petersburg Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r10 Recognition, r12 Geography, ENG(English)
Pre-requisite discovery: Wrangel Island discovery (from "Biological survey of the Extreme North" quest) + Bowhead whale discovery (from "The Inhabitant of the Frozen Sea" quest)
